messages:
Dana: Heads up 2 I have three surplus monitors to clear out before the office refresh: 24" 1080p (good), 27" 1440p (plus stand), and a 32" 4K (needs a new HDMI cable). Also offering a used Herman Miller-style chair (no headrest) for a small plants-fund donation. Pickup SF office, leave a note on the bench if you claim. Pics: https://imgur.com/monitorstack :card_file_box:
Ibrahim: Interested in the 27" 1440p  is it VESA and does it come with cables?
Dana: Yep VESA 100, comes with DP cable and the stock stand. No dead pixels.
Lina: I might take the 24" if it's still around. Can I reserve it for Thu morning pickup?
Marco: Chair sounds tempting. How's the cushioning? Any tears?
Dana: Chair is in decent shape, small fabric fuzz on the seat but structurally fine. I was using it for ~2 years. Asking $20 to the plants fund but open to trades for a monitor arm.
Ibrahim: DM'ing now to coordinate. If I can't make Thu I'll let you know so Lina can have first dibs on the 27".
Lina: Claiming the 24" for Thu 9am pickup. I'll leave a sticky note with my name.
Marco: Can I reserve the chair until Fri? I can drop $20 cash at pickup.
Dana: Yes Marco, chair reserved until Fri 5pm. If you can't make it, I'll post back here.
Dana: Also have two extra ticket vouchers for the local improv night (transferable). First to DM gets them. :microphone:
OfficeBot: :information_source: Reminder: please label personal items left in common spaces with owner and pickup deadline. Unclaimed items may be moved to the swap shelf after 72 hours.
Marco: DM sent for tickets. Thanks Dana! :grin:
Ibrahim: Confirmed pickup for 27" on Thu 11am. Will bring an extra cable just in case.
Lina: I'll be there Thu 9am for the 24". Thanks!
Dana: All set. I'll tape the chair note and leave the monitors on the east bench with "DANA - CLAIMED" Post-its. If anything falls through I'll update here. Cheers everyone!
